# Initial Data Cleaning

  Let's import the data and check for abnormalities. More specifically, we're importing the data and looking for odd patterns like: \\ 
  - NA values where there should be something else (like a 0 or a "False") \\
  - Columns where every/nearly every participant responded the same \\
  - Variables out of order \\
  - Columns that need reformatting (ex. "1 - Least satisfied" and "2" in the same column, or "1 2 3 0 9" which should be one column each for "1" "2", etc.) \\
  - Anything else that looks unusual or wrong \\
  
  Some NA values are fine, we're just especially concerned with those in columns where we need to do analysis. Those include the DCE responses*, 3-study method questions (Househofer, etc), the activity response section, and the demographics. To start, take a look at the data and see if anything looks weird to you, I've typed up my initial thoughts below. When I figured something out while working with the data, I indicate it below as well. \\
  
  *You might notice the returningresults_merged dataset doesn't have the DCE data. For some reason, it's separate in SurveyCTO-- that's okay, we just have to join the datasets together. To begin with, look at the datasets separately and we'll join them in a later step. \\

```{r Initialize}
dcedata <- bind_rows(kagera_dcedata, dar_dcedata)

# Augment the DCE dataset with the scenarios set

  dcedata |> 
    filter(is.na(SET.OF.dce_game) | is.na(game_matrix))
  
  joinedsurveydata |> 
    filter(is.na(SET.OF.dce_game))
  
  scenarios |>
    filter(is.na(image))

  # Augment the DCE dataset with the scenarios dataset (so that we have a column with each feature's level for A and B)
  dcedata_aug <- left_join(dcedata, scenarios, by = join_by(game_matrix == image), suffix = c(".Collected", ".Generated"))

  # Join the augmented DCE dataset to the Survey data
  fulldata <- left_join(dcedata_aug, joinedsurveydata, by = c("SET.OF.dce_game"))

  mutate(
    respondentID = coalesce(respondentid, respondentID),
    KEY = coalesce(KEY.x, KEY.y),
    districtID = coalesce(districtID.x, districtID.y),
    wardID = coalesce(wardID.x, wardID.y),
    villageID = coalesce(villageID.x, villageID.y)
  ) %>%
  select(-ends_with(".x"), -ends_with(".y"), -respondentid)
  
  #Some of the rows refuse to merge correctly. This code tries to fix that by coalescing these rows (which shouldn't lose anything)
    rows_with_merge_problems <- fulldata %>% group_by(respondentID, game_index) %>% 
      filter(n() > 1) %>%
      arrange(respondentID, game_index)
    
    merge_problem_row_IDs <- unique(as.numeric(as.character(rows_with_merge_problems$respondentID)))
    coalesced_rows <- rows_with_merge_problems %>%
      filter(respondentID %in% merge_problem_row_IDs) %>%
      group_by(respondentID, game_index) %>%
      summarise(across(everything(), ~coalesce(.[1], .[2])), .groups = "drop")
    
    fulldata_withoutproblemrows <- subset(fulldata, !(respondentID %in% merge_problem_row_IDs))
    fulldata <- bind_rows(fulldata_withoutproblemrows, coalesced_rows)
  
# Data Cleaning

  # rank_results_preference
  # rank_formats_preference
  # rank_formats_clarity

max_splits <- max(sapply(strsplit(fulldata$rank_results_methods, " "), length)) # Determine max splits
fulldata <- fulldata %>%
  tidyr::separate(rank_results_methods, into = paste0("rank_results_methods_", 1:max_splits), sep = " ", convert = TRUE, fill = "right") %>%
  tidyr::separate(rank_results_preference, into = paste0("rank_results_preference_", 1:3), sep = " ", convert = TRUE, fill = "right") %>%
  tidyr::separate(rank_formats_preference, into = paste0("rank_formats_preference_", 1:3), sep = " ", convert = TRUE, fill = "right") %>%
  tidyr::separate(rank_formats_clarity, into = paste0("rank_formats_clarity_", 1:3), sep = " ", convert = TRUE, fill = "right") %>%

  tidyr::separate(third_position, into = c("third_study", "third_method"), sep = " ", convert = TRUE, fill = "right")

  # Rename the option_selected variable from the misspelled version
  fulldata <- fulldata %>%
    rename(option_selected = dce_potion)
  
  # Recode the option_selected variable as 1 - A and 0 - B rather than 1 - A and 2 - B
  fulldata <- fulldata %>%
    mutate(
      option_selected = ifelse(option_selected == 1, 1, 0)
      )
  
  # Add columns for each of 5 features, levels, for each A and B (1 if present, 0 else)
  features <- colnames(dcedata_aug)[9:19]
  features <- features[features != "compset"]
  fulldata <- dummy_cols(fulldata, select_columns = features)

  # Create comp_delta and funding_delta for continuous features
  fulldata$comp_delta <- NA
  fulldata$funding_delta <- NA
  i = 1
  
  fulldata <- fulldata %>%
    mutate(
      compA = as.numeric(gsub("Tsh.jpeg", "", compensation_image.A)),
      compB = as.numeric(gsub("Tsh.jpeg", "", compensation_image.B)),
      comp_delta = compA - compB,
      fundA = as.numeric(gsub("^research|\\.jpeg$", "", researchfunding_image.A)),
      fundB = as.numeric(gsub("^research|\\.jpeg$", "", researchfunding_image.B)),
      funding_delta = fundA - fundB
    )

#Read in the codebook of variable names and types, adjust types that are incorrect
codebook <- read.csv("../Datasets/codebook.csv")

colnames(codebook) <- c("Variable_Name", "Type")

for (i in seq_len(nrow(codebook))) {
  var_name <- codebook$Variable_Name[i]
  expected_type <- codebook$Type[i]
  
  if (var_name %in% names(fulldata)) {
    current_var <- fulldata[[var_name]]
    
    # Recode based on expected type and print action
    if (expected_type == "factor" && !is.factor(current_var)) {
      fulldata[[var_name]] <- as.factor(current_var)
      #print(paste("Converted", var_name, "to factor."))
      
    } else if (expected_type == "ordinal" && !is.ordered(current_var)) {
      fulldata[[var_name]] <- factor(current_var, ordered = TRUE)
      #print(paste("Converted", var_name, "to ordered factor (ordinal)."))
      
    } else if (expected_type == "numerical" && !is.numeric(current_var)) {
      fulldata[[var_name]] <- as.numeric(as.character(current_var))
      #print(paste("Converted", var_name, "to numeric."))
      
    } 
    # You can also optionally report if the variable already matched
    # else {
    #   print(paste(var_name, "already has correct type:", class(current_var)))
    # }
    
  } else {
    warning(paste("Variable", var_name, "not found in fulldata."))
  }
}
  # num_past_studies has NAs that should be 0 when past_study_participation is 0
fulldata$num_past_studies[is.na(fulldata$num_past_studies) & fulldata$past_study_participation == 0] <- 0

#Save the full dataset after processing but before dropping inattentive set
fulldatapredrop <- fulldata

fulldata <- subset(fulldata, respondentID != 111 | respondentID != 215 | respondentID != 234 | respondentID != 238)

# Drop the inattentive participants 
fulldata <- subset(fulldata, as.numeric(exercise_comment) < 3)
fulldata <- subset(fulldata, !(as.numeric(interviewer) == 1 & districtID != 1)) # DistrictID is 1 for all of Dar. Dar interviewer 1 is fine, just Kagera interviewer 1 is a problem. If you change this logic, also update the DCE dataset and the other analyses!

write.csv(fulldata, file = "postscriptrun_processed_dataset.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r Summary Balance Table}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(janitor)
library(scales)

# Create group labels
fulldatapredrop <- fulldatapredrop %>%
  mutate(group = case_when(
    is.na(control) ~ "Full Sample",  # In case any missing
    control == 0 ~ "Treatment",
    control == 1 ~ "Control"
  ))

# Expand to include all three groups
full_data <- bind_rows(
  fulldatapredrop %>% mutate(group = "Full Sample"),
  fulldatapredrop %>% filter(control == 0) %>% mutate(group = "Treatment"),
  fulldatapredrop %>% filter(control == 1) %>% mutate(group = "Control")
)

# ========================
# Summarize numeric/binary vars
# ========================
numeric_summary <- full_data %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(
    `Average Age` = mean(resp_age, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Employed (%)` = mean(work_seven_days == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Past Study Participation (%)` = mean(past_study_participation == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Average # of Past Studies` = mean(replace_na(num_past_studies, 0)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(-group, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value")

# ========================
# Gender %
# ========================
gender_props <- full_data %>%
  count(group, resp_gender) %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(
    group,
    variable = paste0("Gender: ", as.character(resp_gender)),
    value = pct
  )

# ========================
# Education %
# ========================
education_props <- full_data %>%
  count(group, resp_education) %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(
    group,
    variable = paste0("Education: ", as.character(resp_education)),
    value = pct
  )

# ========================
# Combine and clean
# ========================
combined_long <- bind_rows(numeric_summary, gender_props, education_props)

# Remove any duplicates by averaging (safe fallback)
combined_long <- combined_long %>%
  group_by(variable, group) %>%
  summarise(value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Pivot wider to transpose
balance_table_transposed <- combined_long %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = value)

# Format values (round or percent)
balance_table_transposed <- balance_table_transposed %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ ifelse(
    grepl("^Average", variable),
    round(., 2),
    percent(., accuracy = 1)
  )))

# Clean column names and display
balance_table_transposed <- balance_table_transposed %>%
  janitor::clean_names() %>%
  rename(Variable = variable)

# Relabel education and gender levels
balance_table_transposed <- balance_table_transposed %>%
  mutate(Variable = case_when(
    Variable == "Education: 1" ~ "Education: No formal education",
    Variable == "Education: 2" ~ "Education: Primary education",
    Variable == "Education: 3" ~ "Education: Secondary education",
    Variable == "Education: 4" ~ "Education: Certificate",
    Variable == "Gender: 1" ~ "Gender: Male",
    Variable == "Gender: 2" ~ "Gender: Female",
    TRUE ~ Variable
  ))

balance_table_transposed <- balance_table_transposed %>%
  select(Variable, full_sample, control, treatment)

# Define the desired row order
row_order <- c(
  "Gender: Male",
  "Gender: Female",
  "Average Age",
  "Education: No formal education",
  "Education: Primary education",
  "Education: Secondary education",
  "Education: Certificate",
  "Employed (%)",
  "Past Study Participation (%)",
  "Average # of Past Studies"
)

# Apply the custom order using a factor
balance_table_transposed <- balance_table_transposed %>%
  mutate(Variable = factor(Variable, levels = row_order)) %>%
  arrange(Variable)

# View result
print(balance_table_transposed)
```

```{r Summary Statistics Table Create the table}
# Separate variables by type
categorical_vars <- summary_subset %>% select(where(~ is.character(.) | is.factor(.)))
numeric_vars <- summary_subset %>% select(where(is.numeric))

# Categorical Summary
cat_summary <- map_df(names(categorical_vars), function(var) {
  var_data <- summary_subset[[var]]
  tab <- table(var_data, useNA = "ifany")
  response_rate <- sum(!is.na(var_data)) / length(var_data)
  tibble(
    Variable = var,
    N_Responses = sum(!is.na(var_data)),
    Missing = sum(is.na(var_data)),
    Response_Rate = percent(response_rate, accuracy = 0.1),
    Response_Summary = str_wrap(paste(names(tab), tab, sep = " = ", collapse = "; "), width = 80)
  )
})

# Numeric Summary
num_summary <- map_df(names(numeric_vars), function(var) {
  var_data <- summary_subset[[var]]
  tibble(
    Variable = var,
    N_Responses = sum(!is.na(var_data)),
    Missing = sum(is.na(var_data)),
    Response_Rate = percent(sum(!is.na(var_data)) / length(var_data), accuracy = 0.1),
    Mean = round(mean(var_data, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Median = round(median(var_data, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    SD = round(sd(var_data, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Range = paste0(round(min(var_data, na.rm = TRUE), 2), " - ", round(max(var_data, na.rm = TRUE), 2))
  )
})

# Use the pretty names
cat_summary <- cat_summary %>%
  mutate(Variable = ifelse(Variable %in% names(pretty_names), pretty_names[Variable], Variable))
num_summary <- num_summary %>%
  mutate(Variable = ifelse(Variable %in% names(pretty_names), pretty_names[Variable], Variable))


# View: Interactive tables
datatable(cat_summary, 
          caption = "Summary of Categorical Variables",
          options = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE))

datatable(num_summary,
          caption = "Summary of Numeric Variables",
          options = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE))


# Alternate View: Pretty and static kable tables
print("Categorical Summary")
cat_summary %>%
  arrange(Variable) %>%
  kable("html", escape = FALSE, caption = "Summary of Categorical Variables") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"))

print("Numeric Summary")
num_summary %>%
  arrange(Variable) %>%
  kable("html", escape = FALSE, caption = "Summary of Numeric Variables") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"))
```

```{r To-Do Mira. Summary Statistics Figures Cleaning, eval = FALSE}
    !!!label_maps[[var]]
  )
}

# combined Table
pretty_summary <- sum_figs_labeled %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.character)) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Value") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Value)) %>%
  mutate(Value = ifelse(is.na(Value), "Missing", Value)) %>%  # optional: keeps code structure if reused
  group_by(Variable, Value) %>%
  summarise(N = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Variable) %>%
  mutate(
    Total = sum(N),
    Percent = round(100 * N / Total, 1),
    Row_Label = Value,
    Count = paste0(N, " (", Percent, "%)"),
    Variable = ifelse(row_number() == 1,
                      paste0(ifelse(Variable %in% names(pretty_names), pretty_names[Variable], Variable),
                             " (n = ", Total, ")"),
                      "")
  ) %>%
  select(Variable, Row_Label, Count)
```

```{r Mira Summary Stats Figures, eval = FALSE}
  summarise(N = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Variable) %>%
  mutate(
    Total = sum(N),
    Percent = round(100 * N / Total, 1),
    Row_Label = Value,
    Count = paste0(N, " (", Percent, "%)")

  mutate(
    # store original name for matching order

  # reorder by original variable order using Variable_raw
  mutate(Variable_raw = factor(Variable_raw, levels = present_vars)) %>%
  arrange(Variable_raw) %>%

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# List of variables you want to plot
bar_vars <- c("study_participants", "non_participants_research_communities",
              "local_community_leaders", "local_government_officials", 
              "foreign_government_officials", "religious_leaders",
              "other_researchers")

custom_labels <- c(
  study_participants = "Study Participants",
  non_participants_research_communities = "Non-Participant Community Members",
  local_community_leaders = "Local Community Leaders",
  local_government_officials = "Local Government Officials",
  foreign_government_officials = "Foreign Government Officials",
  religious_leaders = "Religious Leaders",
  other_researchers = "Other Researchers"
)

bar_data_grouped <- sum_figs_labeled %>%
  select(all_of(names(custom_labels))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Response") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Response)) %>%
  group_by(Variable, Response) %>%
  summarise(N = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    Variable = factor(Variable, levels = names(custom_labels)),
    Label = custom_labels[as.character(Variable)]
  )

ggplot(bar_data_grouped, aes(x = Label, y = N, fill = Response)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0("n = ", N)),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    vjust = -0.5,
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Should Study Results Be Shared? Responses by Group",
    x = "Stakeholder Group",
    y = "Number of Respondents",
    fill = "Response"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Yes" = "#2eab67",
      "No" = "#cc3366",
      "Unsure" = "#afcefc"
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1)
  )

ggplot(bar_data_grouped, aes(x = N, y = Label, fill = Response)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0("n = ", N)),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    hjust = -0.1,
    size = 2.5
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Study Results Should be Shared With:",
    y = "Stakeholder Group",
    x = "Number of Respondents",
    fill = "Response"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Yes" = "#2eab67",
      "No" = "#cc3366",
```

```{r IRB Guidelines Etc}
irb_guide <- read_csv("../Datasets/irb_guide.csv")
View(irb_guide)

irb_summary_nested <- irb_guide %>%
  filter(type == "Professional") %>%
  group_by(type, field) %>%
  summarise(
    n_organizations = n(),
    with_ethics_doc = sum(ethics_doc, na.rm = TRUE),
    with_return_results = sum(return_results, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

library(dplyr)
library(kableExtra)

# Total summary (including Professional as one row)
total_summary <- irb_guide %>%
  group_by(type) %>%
  summarise(
    n_organizations = n(),
    with_ethics_doc = sum(ethics_doc, na.rm = TRUE),
    with_return_results = sum(return_results, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(field = NA_character_)

# Sub-summary for Professional
professional_subsummary <- irb_guide %>%
  filter(type == "Professional") %>%
  group_by(field) %>%
  summarise(
    n_organizations = n(),
    with_ethics_doc = sum(ethics_doc, na.rm = TRUE),
    with_return_results = sum(return_results, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    type = "",  # blank to avoid repetition
    field = paste0("  ", field)  # indent field names
  ) %>%
  select(type, field, everything())

# Combine total and sub rows
final_table <- bind_rows(
  total_summary %>% filter(type != "Professional"),
  total_summary %>% filter(type == "Professional"),
  professional_subsummary
)

# Create pretty table
final_table %>%
  select(type, field, everything()) %>%
  kable(format = "html", caption = "Summary of IRB Guidelines by Type and Subfield") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE, position = "center")
```

```{r Summary Stats Figures with Percentages (Elyse Adapting Mira's code), eval = FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

bar_vars <- c("study_participants", "non_participants_research_communities",
              "local_community_leaders", "local_government_officials", 
              "foreign_government_officials", "religious_leaders",
              "other_researchers")

custom_labels <- c(
  study_participants = "Study Participants",
  non_participants_research_communities = "Non-Participant Community Members",
  local_community_leaders = "Local Community Leaders",
  local_government_officials = "Local Government Officials",
  foreign_government_officials = "Foreign Government Officials",
  religious_leaders = "Religious Leaders",
  other_researchers = "Other Researchers"
)

bar_data_grouped <- sum_figs_labeled %>%
  select(all_of(names(custom_labels))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Response") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Response)) %>%
  group_by(Variable, Response) %>%
  summarise(N = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Variable) %>%
  mutate(
    Percent = round(100 * N / sum(N), 1),
    Count_Label = paste0("n = ", N, "\n(", Percent, "%)")
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    Variable = factor(Variable, levels = names(custom_labels)),
    Label = custom_labels[as.character(Variable)]
  )

bar_data_grouped <- subset(bar_data_grouped, Response == "Yes")

# Vertical grouped bar chart with counts + percentages
ggplot(bar_data_grouped, aes(x = Label, y = N, fill = Response)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = Count_Label),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    vjust = -0.5,
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Should Study Results Be Shared? Responses by Group",
    x = "Stakeholder Group",
    y = "Number of Respondents",
    fill = "Response"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Yes" = "#2eab67", "No" = "#cc3366", "Unsure" = "#afcefc")
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1)
  )

# Horizontal grouped bar chart with counts + percentages
bar_data_sorted <- bar_data_grouped %>%
  group_by(Label) %>%
  mutate(TotalN = sum(N)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Label = fct_reorder(Label, TotalN, .desc = FALSE))

# Plot
ggplot(bar_data_sorted, aes(x = N, y = Label, fill = Response)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = Count_Label),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    hjust = -0.1,
    size = 2.5
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Study Results Should be Shared With:",
    y = "Stakeholder Group",
    x = "Number of Respondents (n = 197)"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Yes" = "skyblue", "No" = "#cc3366", "Unsure" = "#afcefc")
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 1.4),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  xlim(0, max(bar_data_grouped$N) * 1.1)

# Response-centered bar chart with counts + percentages
ggplot(bar_data_grouped, aes(x = Response, y = N, fill = Label)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = Count_Label),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
    vjust = -0.5,
    size = 3.2
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Responses by Group: Who Should Receive Study Results?",
    x = "Response Category",
    y = "Number of Respondents",
    fill = "Stakeholder Group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

# Enrollment reasons chart with percentage labels

  filter(!is.na(enrol_study)) %>%
  group_by(Reason = enrol_study) %>%
  summarise(N = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%

ggplot(enrol_data, aes(x = N, y = reorder(Reason, N))) +
```

```{r To-do. Summary Statistics Table fixes, eval = FALSE}
# Fifth Choice Summary

  arrange(desc(Count))
 

 
# Sixth Choice Summary

  arrange(desc(Count))
 

 
# Seventh Choice Summary

  mutate(Method = method_labels[rownames(.)],

  arrange(desc(Count))
 

 
# Eighth Choice Summary
 
eighth_choice <- data.frame(

  mutate(Method = method_labels[rownames(.)],

# Ninth Choice Summary

         Rank = "Ninth Choice") %>%
 
  arrange(desc(Count))
 

 
# combined summaries 
 
summary_rank_table <- rbind(first_choice, second_choice, third_choice, fourth_choice,
 
      fifth_choice, sixth_choice, seventh_choice, eighth_choice,
 
      ninth_choice) %>%
 
  select(Rank, Method, Count)
 

 

 
# calculating percentages to be used in heat map 
 
heatmap_data_pct <- summary_rank_table %>%
 
  group_by(Rank) %>%
 
  mutate(Percentage = Count/sum(Count) * 100) %>%
 
  ungroup() %>%
 
  mutate(
 
    Rank = factor(Rank, 
 
                 levels = c("First Choice", "Second Choice", "Third Choice", 
 
                          "Fourth Choice", "Fifth Choice", "Sixth Choice",
 
                          "Seventh Choice", "Eighth Choice", "Ninth Choice")),
 
    Method = factor(Method)
 
  )
 

 

 
# creating a heatmap plot
 
heatmap <- ggplot(heatmap_data_pct, aes(x = Rank, y = Method, fill = Percentage)) +
 
  geom_tile() +
 
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.0f%%", Percentage)), 
 
            color = "white", size = 3) +
 
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
 
  theme_minimal() +
 
  theme(
 
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
 
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
 
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
 
  ) +
 
  labs(
 
    title = "Distribution of Rankings for Each Communication Method",
 
    x = "Rank Position",
 
    y = "Communication Method",
 
    fill = "Percentage of\nResponses"
 
  )
 

 

# ranked choice voting analysis - Borda Count
 

# Assigns points based on rank to each selection
 


 

borda_scores <- rankings %>%
 

  mutate(across(starts_with("methods_rank_"), as.character)) %>%
 

  pivot_longer(
 

    cols = starts_with("methods_rank_"),
 

    names_to = "rank",
 

    values_to = "method"
 

  ) %>%
 

  mutate(
 

    points = case_when(
 

      rank == "methods_rank_first_choice" ~ 9,
 

      rank == "methods_rank_second_choice" ~ 8,
 

      rank == "methods_rank_third_choice" ~ 7,
 

      rank == "methods_rank_fourth_choice" ~ 6,
 

      rank == "methods_rank_fifth_choice" ~ 5,
 

      rank == "methods_rank_sixth_choice" ~ 4,
 

      rank == "methods_rank_seventh_choice" ~ 3,
 

      rank == "methods_rank_eighth_choice" ~ 2,
 

      rank == "methods_rank_ninth_choice" ~ 1
 

    )
 

  ) %>%
 

  group_by(method) %>%
 

  summarize(
 

    total_points = sum(points, na.rm = TRUE)
 

  ) %>%
 

  mutate(
 

    method_name = method_labels[method],
 

    percentage = round(total_points/sum(total_points) * 100, 2)
 

  ) %>%
 

  arrange(desc(total_points)) %>%
 

  select(method_name, total_points, percentage)
 


 

borda_scores <- borda_scores %>%
 

  arrange(desc(total_points)) %>%
 

  kable("html", escape = FALSE, caption = "Borda Count Ranked Choice Voting Results", col.names = c("Communication Method","Total Points", "Percentage")) %>%
 

  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"))
 


 

summary_rank_table <- summary_rank_table %>%
 

  #arrange(desc(total_points)) %>%
 

  kable("html", escape = FALSE, caption = "Rankings Summary Statistics") %>%
 

  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"))
```

```{r Rank results methods 1-9. Stacked Bar Chart Visualization, eval = FALSE}
         Rank = "First Choice") %>%
  arrange(desc(Count))

# Second Choice Summary
second_choice <- data.frame(
  Count = summary(rankings$methods_rank_second_choice)) %>%
  mutate(Method = method_labels[rownames(.)],
         Rank = "Second Choice") %>%
  arrange(desc(Count))

# Third Choice Summary
third_choice <- data.frame(
  Count = summary(rankings$methods_rank_third_choice)) %>%
  mutate(Method = method_labels[rownames(.)],
         Rank = "Third Choice") %>%
  arrange(desc(Count))

# Fourth Choice Summary
fourth_choice <- data.frame(
  Count = summary(rankings$methods_rank_fourth_choice)) %>%
  mutate(Method = method_labels[rownames(.)],
         Rank = "Fourth Choice") %>%
  arrange(desc(Count))

# Fifth Choice Summary
fifth_choice <- data.frame(
  Count = summary(rankings$methods_rank_fifth_choice)) %>%
  mutate(Method = method_labels[rownames(.)],
         Rank = "Fifth Choice") %>%
  arrange(desc(Count))

# Sixth Choice Summary
sixth_choice <- data.frame(
  Count = summary(rankings$methods_rank_sixth_choice)) %>%
  mutate(Method = method_labels[rownames(.)],
         Rank = "Sixth Choice") %>%
  arrange(desc(Count))

# Seventh Choice Summary
seventh_choice <- data.frame(
  Count = summary(rankings$methods_rank_seventh_choice)) %>%
  mutate(Method = method_labels[rownames(.)],
         Rank = "Seventh Choice") %>%
  arrange(desc(Count))

# Eighth Choice Summary
eighth_choice <- data.frame(
  Count = summary(rankings$methods_rank_eighth_choice)) %>%
  mutate(Method = method_labels[rownames(.)],
         Rank = "Eighth Choice") %>%
  arrange(desc(Count))

# Ninth Choice Summary
ninth_choice <- data.frame(
  Count = summary(rankings$methods_rank_ninth_choice)) %>%
  mutate(Method = method_labels[rownames(.)],
         Rank = "Ninth Choice") %>%
  arrange(desc(Count))

# combined summaries 
summary_rank_table <- rbind(first_choice, second_choice, third_choice, fourth_choice,
      fifth_choice, sixth_choice, seventh_choice, eighth_choice,
      ninth_choice) %>%
  select(Rank, Method, Count)


# calculating percentages to be used in heat map 
heatmap_data_pct <- summary_rank_table %>%
  group_by(Rank) %>%
  mutate(Percentage = Count/sum(Count) * 100) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    Rank = factor(Rank, 
                 levels = c("First Choice", "Second Choice", "Third Choice", 
                          "Fourth Choice", "Fifth Choice", "Sixth Choice",
                          "Seventh Choice", "Eighth Choice", "Ninth Choice")),
    Method = factor(Method)
  )


# creating a heatmap plot
heatmap <- ggplot(heatmap_data_pct, aes(x = Rank, y = Method, fill = Percentage)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.0f%%", Percentage)), 
            color = "white", size = 3) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Rankings for Each Communication Method",
    x = "Rank Position",
    y = "Communication Method",
    fill = "Percentage of\nResponses"
  )

# ranked choice voting analysis - Borda Count
# Assigns points based on rank to each selection

borda_scores <- rankings %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("methods_rank_"), as.character)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("methods_rank_"),
    names_to = "rank",
    values_to = "method"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    points = case_when(
      rank == "methods_rank_first_choice" ~ 9,
      rank == "methods_rank_second_choice" ~ 8,
      rank == "methods_rank_third_choice" ~ 7,
      rank == "methods_rank_fourth_choice" ~ 6,
      rank == "methods_rank_fifth_choice" ~ 5,
      rank == "methods_rank_sixth_choice" ~ 4,
      rank == "methods_rank_seventh_choice" ~ 3,
      rank == "methods_rank_eighth_choice" ~ 2,
      rank == "methods_rank_ninth_choice" ~ 1
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(method) %>%
  summarize(
    total_points = sum(points, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    method_name = method_labels[method],
    percentage = round(total_points/sum(total_points) * 100, 2)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_points)) %>%
  select(method_name, total_points, percentage)

borda_scores <- borda_scores %>%
  arrange(desc(total_points)) %>%
  kable("html", escape = FALSE, caption = "Borda Count Ranked Choice Voting Results", col.names = c("Communication Method","Total Points", "Percentage")) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"))

summary_rank_table <- summary_rank_table %>%
  #arrange(desc(total_points)) %>%
  kable("html", escape = FALSE, caption = "Rankings Summary Statistics") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"))
```

```{r Rank results methods 1-9. Rank Order Logit, eval = FALSE}
rankings <- fulldata
rankings <- rankings %>%
  distinct(respondentID, 
          rank_results_methods_1,
          rank_results_methods_2,
          rank_results_methods_3,
          rank_results_methods_4,
          rank_results_methods_5,
          rank_results_methods_6,
          rank_results_methods_7,
          rank_results_methods_8,
          rank_results_methods_9,
          .keep_all = TRUE)

method_labels <- c(
  "1" = "Audio Message (Baseline)",
  "2" = "SMS",
  "3" = "Website",
  "4" = "Flyer (Individual)",
  "5" = "Flyer (Public)",
  "6" = "Social Media Post",
  "7" = "Video",
  "8" = "Public Meeting",
  "9" = "Private Meeting"
)

# stacked ranking
stacked_rankings <- rankings %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("rank_results_methods_"), as.character)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("rank_results_methods_"),
    names_to = "choice",
    values_to = "method"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    choice = str_remove(choice, "rank_results_methods_"))

stacked_rankings <- stacked_rankings %>%
  mutate(
    respondentID = as.character(respondentID),
    method = as.character(method),
    choice = as.integer(choice)
  )

mlogit_data <- dfidx(data = stacked_rankings,
                     idx = c("respondentID", "method"),
                     choice = "choice",
                     shape = "long",
                     ranked = TRUE)

model_ranked <- mlogit(choice ~ method | control, data = mlogit_data)
summary(model_ranked)


coefplot(model_ranked, horiz = TRUE, main = "Ranked Logit Coefficients")
# The coefplot is okay, but misleading (since the Control/Treatment interaction is *relative to the baseline*). Let's fix that by plotting both on the same set of axes (and with the "change" recorded in the Control:Term added to the relevant baseline value). 


#Compute confidence intervals
coefs <- broom::tidy(model_ranked, conf.int = TRUE)

#Process coefficients
ci_data <- coefs %>%
  mutate(
    term_type = case_when(
      str_detect(term, "^\\(Intercept\\):") ~ "intercept",
      str_detect(term, "^control:") ~ "control",
      TRUE ~ "other"
    ),
    method_num = case_when(
      term_type == "intercept" ~ str_remove(term, "^\\(Intercept\\):"),
      term_type == "control" ~ str_remove(term, "^control:"),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(term_type != "other") %>%
  select(term_type, method_num, estimate, conf.low, conf.high) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = term_type,
    values_from = c(estimate, conf.low, conf.high)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    method_label = method_labels[method_num],
    treatment = estimate_intercept,
    treatment_low = conf.low_intercept,
    treatment_high = conf.high_intercept,
    control = estimate_intercept + estimate_control,
    control_low = conf.low_intercept + conf.low_control,
    control_high = conf.high_intercept + conf.high_control
  )

#Add baseline manually
ci_data <- ci_data %>%
  add_row(
    method_num = "1",
    method_label = method_labels["1"],
    treatment = 0,
    treatment_low = 0,
    treatment_high = 0,
    control = 0,
    control_low = 0,
    control_high = 0
  )

#Reshape for plotting
ci_plot_data <- ci_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("treatment", "control"), names_to = "group", values_to = "estimate") %>%
  mutate(
    lower = case_when(
      group == "treatment" ~ treatment_low,
      group == "control" ~ control_low
    ),
    upper = case_when(
      group == "treatment" ~ treatment_high,
      group == "control" ~ control_high
    )
  )

#Plot with confidence intervals
ggplot(ci_plot_data, aes(x = estimate, 
                         y = fct_reorder(method_label, estimate, .desc = FALSE), 
                         color = group)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper), height = 0.2, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  labs(
    title = "Rank-Ordered Logit of Returning Methods",
    x = "Rank-Order Coefficient (with 95% CI)",
    y = "",
    color = "Group"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("treatment" = "darkblue", "control" = "firebrick")) +
  theme_minimal()

#Extract coefficients and standard errors
coefs <- broom::tidy(model_ranked, conf.int = TRUE)

#Classify term type and extract method number
coefs <- coefs %>%
  mutate(
    term_type = case_when(
      str_detect(term, "^\\(Intercept\\):") ~ "intercept",
      str_detect(term, "^control:") ~ "control",
      TRUE ~ "other"
    ),
    method_num = case_when(
      term_type == "intercept" ~ str_remove(term, "^\\(Intercept\\):"),
      term_type == "control" ~ str_remove(term, "^control:"),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(term_type != "other")

#Merge intercept and control rows
table_data <- coefs %>%
  select(term_type, method_num, estimate, std.error, p.value) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = term_type,
    values_from = c(estimate, std.error, p.value)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    method_label = method_labels[method_num],
    treatment_coef = estimate_intercept,
    treatment_se   = std.error_intercept,
    treatment_p    = p.value_intercept,
    control_coef   = estimate_intercept + estimate_control,
    control_se     = sqrt(std.error_intercept^2 + std.error_control^2), # approximate
    control_p      = p.value_control
  ) %>%
  select(method_label, starts_with("treatment"), starts_with("control"))

#Add baseline manually (Audio Message)
baseline_row <- tibble(
  method_label = method_labels["1"],
  treatment_coef = 0,
  treatment_se = NA,
  treatment_p = NA,
  control_coef = 0,
  control_se = NA,
  control_p = NA
)

table_data <- bind_rows(baseline_row, table_data) %>%
  arrange(treatment_coef)

#Format values and significance stars
format_with_stars <- function(est, p) {
  stars <- case_when(
    is.na(p) ~ "",
    p < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p < 0.01 ~ "**",
    p < 0.05 ~ "*",
    TRUE ~ ""
  )
  sprintf("%.3f%s", est, stars)
}

format_se <- function(se) {
  ifelse(is.na(se), "", sprintf("(%.3f)", se))
}

final_table <- table_data %>%
  mutate(
    Treatment = paste0(format_with_stars(treatment_coef, treatment_p), "\n", format_se(treatment_se)),
    Control   = paste0(format_with_stars(control_coef, control_p), "\n", format_se(control_se))
  ) %>%
  select(`Method` = method_label, Treatment, Control)

#Create nicely styled table
final_table %>%
  kable(format = "html", escape = FALSE, align = c("l", "c", "c")) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover")) %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)
```

```{r Three study experiment. Rank Order Logit (with and without inattentive subset), eval = FALSE}

# Clean code for the three study experiment analysis. Generate dummy var for study, position, method
threestudy_analysis <- select(fulldatapredrop, c("respondentID", "first_study", "first_method", "second_study", "second_method", 
"third_study", "third_method", "rank_results_preference_1", "rank_results_preference_2", 
"rank_results_preference_3", "rank_formats_preference_1", "rank_formats_preference_2", 
"rank_formats_preference_3", "rank_formats_clarity_1", "rank_formats_clarity_2", "rank_formats_clarity_3", "control", "exercise_comment", "interviewer"))

threestudy_analysis <- threestudy_analysis[!duplicated(threestudy_analysis), ]

# Checking for empty rows
empty_preference_rows <- subset(threestudy_analysis, is.na(rank_results_preference_1) & is.na(rank_results_preference_2) & is.na(rank_results_preference_3))

threestudy_analysis <- subset(threestudy_analysis, !is.na(rank_results_preference_1) & !is.na(rank_results_preference_2) & !is.na(rank_results_preference_3))

threestudy_analysis <- threestudy_analysis %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("first_study", "first_method", "second_study", "second_method", "third_study", "third_method"),
               names_to = c("order", ".value"),
               names_sep = "_") %>%
  mutate(order = factor(order, levels = c("first", "second", "third")))

threestudy_analysis <- dummy_cols(threestudy_analysis, select_columns = c("rank_results_preference_1", "rank_results_preference_2", "rank_results_preference_3"))
threestudy_analysis <- dummy_cols(threestudy_analysis, select_columns = c("rank_formats_preference_1", "rank_formats_preference_2", "rank_formats_preference_3"))
threestudy_analysis <- dummy_cols(threestudy_analysis, select_columns = c("rank_formats_clarity_1", "rank_formats_clarity_2", "rank_formats_clarity_3"))
threestudy_analysis$results_preference_ranking <- NA
threestudy_analysis$formats_preference_ranking <- NA
threestudy_analysis$formats_clarity_ranking <- NA

# Now we want to translate this ranking into a long format that records study, order, method, and the three types of preference ranking standing
j = 1
numrows <- nrow(threestudy_analysis)

while(j <= numrows) {
    current_row <- threestudy_analysis[j,]
    order_num = case_when(
      current_row$order == "first" ~ 1,
      current_row$order == "second" ~ 2,
      current_row$order == "third" ~ 3
    )
    results_preference_ranking = case_when(
      #Read these as "if the current row is the "first" study and the #1 rank results preference is study 1/"first", then results_pref_ranking = 1", etc.
      current_row$order == "first" & current_row$rank_results_preference_1_1 == 1 ~ 1,
      current_row$order == "second" & current_row$rank_results_preference_1_2 == 1 ~ 1,
      current_row$order == "third" & current_row$rank_results_preference_1_3 == 1 ~ 1,
      #Read these as "if the current row is the "first" study and the #2 rank results preference is study 1/"first", then results_pref_ranking = 2", etc.
      current_row$order == "first" & current_row$rank_results_preference_2_1 == 1 ~ 2,
      current_row$order == "second" & current_row$rank_results_preference_2_2 == 1 ~ 2,
      current_row$order == "third" & current_row$rank_results_preference_2_3 == 1 ~ 2,
      #Read these as "if the current row is the "first" study and the #3 rank results preference is study 1/"first", then results_pref_ranking = 3", etc.
      current_row$order == "first" & current_row$rank_results_preference_3_1 == 1 ~ 3,
      current_row$order == "second" & current_row$rank_results_preference_3_2 == 1 ~ 3,
      current_row$order == "third" & current_row$rank_results_preference_3_3 == 1 ~ 3
    )
    threestudy_analysis[j, "results_preference_ranking"] <- results_preference_ranking

    formats_preference_ranking = case_when(
      current_row$order == "first" & current_row$rank_formats_preference_1_1 == 1 ~ 1,
      current_row$order == "second" & current_row$rank_formats_preference_1_2 == 1 ~ 1,
      current_row$order == "third" & current_row$rank_formats_preference_1_3 == 1 ~ 1,
      current_row$order == "first" & current_row$rank_formats_preference_2_1 == 1 ~ 2,
      current_row$order == "second" & current_row$rank_formats_preference_2_2 == 1 ~ 2,
      current_row$order == "third" & current_row$rank_formats_preference_2_3 == 1 ~ 2,
      current_row$order == "first" & current_row$rank_formats_preference_3_1 == 1 ~ 3,
      current_row$order == "second" & current_row$rank_formats_preference_3_2 == 1 ~ 3,
      current_row$order == "third" & current_row$rank_formats_preference_3_3 == 1 ~ 3,
    )
    threestudy_analysis[j, "formats_preference_ranking"] <- formats_preference_ranking
    
    formats_clarity_ranking = case_when(
      current_row$order == "first" & current_row$rank_formats_clarity_1_1 == 1 ~ 1,
      current_row$order == "second" & current_row$rank_formats_clarity_1_2 == 1 ~ 1,
      current_row$order == "third" & current_row$rank_formats_clarity_1_3 == 1 ~ 1,
      current_row$order == "first" & current_row$rank_formats_clarity_2_1 == 1 ~ 2,
      current_row$order == "second" & current_row$rank_formats_clarity_2_2 == 1 ~ 2,
      current_row$order == "third" & current_row$rank_formats_clarity_2_3 == 1 ~ 2,
      current_row$order == "first" & current_row$rank_formats_clarity_3_1 == 1 ~ 3,
      current_row$order == "second" & current_row$rank_formats_clarity_3_2 == 1 ~ 3,
      current_row$order == "third" & current_row$rank_formats_clarity_3_3 == 1 ~ 3,
    )
    threestudy_analysis[j, "formats_clarity_ranking"] <- formats_clarity_ranking
    
    j <- j + 1
}

format_mlogit_table <- function(model1, model2, model_names = c("Attentive", "All (incl. inattentive)")) {
  tidy1 <- broom::tidy(model1) %>% mutate(model = model_names[1])
  tidy2 <- broom::tidy(model2) %>% mutate(model = model_names[2])
  
  combined <- bind_rows(tidy1, tidy2) %>%
    mutate(
      estimate_fmt = sprintf("%.2f", estimate),
      std.error_fmt = sprintf("(%.2f)", std.error),
      stars = case_when(
        p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p.value < 0.01 ~ "**",
        p.value < 0.05 ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ ""
      ),
      coef_display = paste0(estimate_fmt, stars, "\n", std.error_fmt)
    ) %>%
    select(term, model, coef_display) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = coef_display) %>%
    mutate(term = recode(term,
      `(Intercept):sms.png`     = "SMS Message (vs. Audio) – Treatment Group Preference",
      `control:sms.png`         = "SMS Message (vs. Audio) – Control Group Preference",
      `(Intercept):video.mp4`   = "Video Message (vs. Audio) – Treatment Group Preference",
      `control:video.mp4`       = "Video Message (vs. Audio) – Control Group Preference",
      `ordersecond`             = "Presented 2nd (vs. 1st)",
      `orderthird`              = "Presented 3rd (vs. 1st)",
      `studyLachlan`            = "Lachlan Study (vs. Househofer)",
      `studyRiley`              = "Riley Study (vs. Househofer)"
    ))

  # Define desired term order
  term_levels <- c(
    "SMS Message (vs. Audio) – Treatment Group Preference",
    "SMS Message (vs. Audio) – Control Group Preference",
    "Video Message (vs. Audio) – Treatment Group Preference",
    "Video Message (vs. Audio) – Control Group Preference",
    "Presented 2nd (vs. 1st)",
    "Presented 3rd (vs. 1st)",
    "Lachlan Study (vs. Househofer)",
    "Riley Study (vs. Househofer)"
  )
  
  # Ensure correct order
  combined <- combined %>%
    mutate(term = factor(term, levels = term_levels)) %>%
    arrange(term)
  
  # Create table
  kbl_out <- kable(combined, format = "html", escape = FALSE, align = "lcc",
                   col.names = c("Term", model_names[1], model_names[2])) %>%
    kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "left") %>%
    add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "Results" = 2)) %>%
    row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) %>%
    group_rows("Controls", 5, 8)  # Lines 5-8 are controls

  return(kbl_out)
}


# ---- Create Tables ----

# 1. Results Preference
format_mlogit_table(
  model1 = threestudy_resultspref_ranked,
  model2 = threestudy_resultspref_ranked_incl_inattentive,
  model_names = c("Attentive", "All (incl. inattentive)")
)

# 2. Formats Preference
format_mlogit_table(
  model1 = threestudy_formatspref_ranked,
  model2 = threestudy_formatspref_ranked_incl_inattentive,
  model_names = c("Attentive", "All (incl. inattentive)")
)

# 3. Formats Clarity
format_mlogit_table(
  model1 = threestudy_formatsclarity_ranked,
  model2 = threestudy_formatsclarity_ranked_incl_inattentive,
  model_names = c("Attentive", "All (incl. inattentive)")
)
```

```{r DCE Initialization Long Dataset}
dceanalysis <- select(fulldatapredrop, #Will drop the inattentives after initializing dce_long
                      c("respondentID", "game_index", "game_matrix", "option_selected", 
                                         "participants_image.A", "community_image.A", "policymakers_image.A", "compensation_image.A", "researchfunding_image.A", 
                                         "participants_image.B", "community_image.B", "policymakers_image.B", "compensation_image.B", "researchfunding_image.B",
                                         "compA", "compB", "fundA", "fundB", "comp_delta", "funding_delta", "compset", "control",
                                         "understood_exercise", "exercise_comment", "exercise_comment_oth", "interviewer", "districtID"))

#Renaming columns for ease of reference
dceanalysis <- dceanalysis %>%
  rename(
    participantA = participants_image.A,
    participantB = participants_image.B,
    communityA = community_image.A,
    communityB = community_image.B,
    policyA = policymakers_image.A,
    policyB = policymakers_image.B, 
    fund_delta = funding_delta
    )

#Listing the columns with the "participant1.jpeg" format data that needs to be extracted
columns_to_process = c("participantA", "participantB", "communityA", "communityB", "policyA", "policyB", "compA", "compB", "fundA", "fundB")

#Extract the number from the "participant1.jpeg" formatting
for (col in columns_to_process) {
  dceanalysis[[col]] <- as.numeric(gsub("\\D+", "", dceanalysis[[col]]))
}

dceanalysis <- dceanalysis %>%
  distinct(respondentID, game_index, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Pivot longer
dce_long <- dceanalysis %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(participantA, participantB, communityA, communityB, policyA, policyB, compA, compB, fundA, fundB),
    names_to = c(".value", "alt"),
    names_pattern = "(.*)(A|B)"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    chosen = ifelse((option_selected == 0 & alt == "B") | (option_selected == 1 & alt == "A"), 1, 0)
  ) %>%
  select(respondentID, game_index, option_selected, chosen, alt, participant, community, policy, comp, fund, control, exercise_comment, interviewer, districtID)

dce_long <- dce_long %>%
  distinct(respondentID, game_index) %>%             # Get unique combinations
  arrange(respondentID, game_index) %>%              # Order them
  mutate(game_id = row_number()) %>%                 # Assign global game_id
  right_join(dce_long, by = c("respondentID", "game_index"))

dce_long$participant <- factor(dce_long$participant,
                               levels = c(1, 2, 3),
                               labels = c("No results returned to participants", "Results returned to participants remotely", "Results returned to participants in person"))

dce_long$community <- factor(dce_long$community,
                               levels = c(1, 2, 3),
                               labels = c("No results returned to community", "Results returned to community leaders remotely", "Results returned to community in-person meeting"))

dce_long$policy <- factor(dce_long$policy,
                               levels = c(1, 2, 3),
                               labels = c("No results returned to policymakers", "Report of results submitted to policymakers", "Results presented in half-day workshop to policymakers"))

dce_long <- dce_long %>%
  mutate(control = factor(control, levels = c(1, 0)))

#Want: returning results to participants chosen ~ community + policy + comp + fund, 
     # returning results to community chosen ~ participants + policy + comp + fund,
     # returning results to policymakers chosen ~ participants + community + comp + fund,

dce_long <- dce_long %>%
  group_by(game_id) %>%
  mutate(
    chosen_participant = participant[chosen == 1],
    other_participant = participant[chosen == 0],
    chosen_community = community[chosen == 1],
    other_community = community[chosen == 0],
    chosen_policy = policy[chosen == 1],
    other_policy = policy[chosen == 0],
    chosen_comp = comp[chosen == 1],
    other_comp = comp[chosen == 0],
    chosen_fund = fund[chosen == 1],
    other_fund = fund[chosen == 0],
    dominant_comp = case_when(
      comp[alt == "A"] > comp[alt == "B"] ~ comp[alt == "A"],
      comp[alt == "B"] > comp[alt == "A"] ~ comp[alt == "B"],
      comp[alt == "A"] == comp[alt == "B"] ~ NA
      ),
    nondominant_comp = case_when(
      comp[alt == "A"] > comp[alt == "B"] ~ comp[alt == "B"],
      comp[alt == "B"] > comp[alt == "A"] ~ comp[alt == "A"],
      comp[alt == "A"] == comp[alt == "B"] ~ NA
    ),
    dominant_fund = case_when(
      fund[alt == "A"] > fund[alt == "B"] ~ fund[alt == "A"],
      fund[alt == "B"] > fund[alt == "A"] ~ fund[alt == "B"],
      fund[alt == "A"] == fund[alt == "B"] ~ NA
      ),
    nondominant_fund = case_when(
      fund[alt == "A"] > fund[alt == "B"] ~ fund[alt == "B"],
      fund[alt == "B"] > fund[alt == "A"] ~ fund[alt == "A"],
      fund[alt == "A"] == fund[alt == "B"] ~ NA
      ),
    chosen_dominant_comp = case_when(
      dominant_comp == NA ~ NA,
      chosen == 1 & dominant_comp == comp ~ 1,
      chosen == 0 & nondominant_comp == comp ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    chosen_dominant_fund = case_when(
      dominant_fund == NA ~ NA,
      chosen == 1 & dominant_fund == fund ~ 1,
      chosen == 0 & nondominant_fund == fund ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    comp_delta = ifelse(!is.na(dominant_comp - nondominant_comp), dominant_comp - nondominant_comp, ifelse(chosen_comp == other_comp, 0, NA)),
    fund_delta = ifelse(!is.na(dominant_fund - nondominant_fund), dominant_fund - nondominant_fund, ifelse(chosen_fund == other_fund, 0, NA)),
    dominant_funding_comp_delta = case_when(
      fund[alt == "A"] == fund[alt == "B"] ~ NA,
      fund[alt == "A"] > fund[alt == "B"] ~ comp[alt == "A"] - comp[alt == "B"],
      fund[alt == "B"] > fund[alt == "A"] ~ comp[alt == "B"] - comp[alt == "A"],
    ),
    return_results_participants = case_when(
      participant[alt == "A"] == participant[alt == "B"] ~ NA,
      participant[alt == "A"] != "No results returned to participants" | participant[alt == "B"] != "No results returned to participants" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    return_results_participants_none = ifelse(participant == "No results returned to participants", 1, 0),
    return_results_participants_remote = ifelse(participant == "Results returned to participants remotely", 1, 0),
    return_results_participants_inperson = ifelse(participant == "Results returned to participants in person", 1, 0),
    return_results_community = case_when(
      community[alt == "A"] == community[alt == "B"] ~ NA,
      community[alt == "A"] != "No results returned to community" | community[alt == "B"] != "No results returned to community" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    return_results_community_none = ifelse(community == "No results returned to community", 1, 0),
    return_results_community_remote = ifelse(community == "Results returned to community leaders remotely", 1, 0),
    return_results_community_inperson = ifelse(community == "Results returned to community in-person meeting", 1, 0),
    return_results_policy = case_when(
      policy[alt == "A"] == policy[alt == "B"] ~ NA,
      policy[alt == "A"] != "No results returned to policymakers" | policy[alt == "B"] != "No results returned to policymakers" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    return_results_policy_none = ifelse(policy == "No results returned to policymakers", 1, 0),
    return_results_policy_remote = ifelse(policy == "Report of results submitted to policymakers", 1, 0),
    return_results_policy_inperson = ifelse(policy == "Results presented in half-day workshop to policymakers", 1, 0),
    return_results_participants_chosen = case_when(
      chosen == 1 &
      chosen_participant %in% c("Results returned to participants remotely", "Results returned to participants in person") &
      chosen_participant != other_participant ~ 1,
      chosen_participant == other_participant ~ NA,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    return_results_community_chosen = case_when(
      chosen == 1 &
      chosen_community %in% c("Results returned to community leaders remotely", "Results returned to community in-person meeting") &
      chosen_community != other_community ~ 1,
      chosen_community == other_community ~ NA,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    return_results_policy_chosen = case_when(
      chosen == 1 &
      chosen_policy %in% c("Report of results submitted to policymakers", "Results presented in half-day workshop to policymakers") &
      chosen_policy != other_policy ~ 1,
      chosen_policy == other_policy ~ NA,
      TRUE ~ 0
    )
    
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

      is.na(dominant_rrc_v2) ~ NA,
      (option_selected == 1 & dominant_rrc_v2[alt == "A"] == 1) | (option_selected == 0 & dominant_rrc_v2[alt == "B"] == 1) ~ 1,
      (option_selected == 1 & dominant_rrc_v2[alt == "A"] == 0) | (option_selected == 0 & dominant_rrc_v2[alt == "B"] == 0) ~ 0,
    ),
    
    dominant_rrc_v2_comp_delta = case_when(
      is.na(dominant_rrc_v2) ~ NA,
      TRUE ~ comp[dominant_rrc_v2 == 1] - comp[dominant_rrc_v2 == 0]
    ),
    
    
    
    #Now for policymakers. Returning results to policymakers --> rrpolicy
    dominant_rrpolicy_v1 = case_when(
      policy[alt == "A"] == policy[alt == "B"] ~ NA,
      policy[alt == "A"] == "Results presented in half-day workshop to policymakers" & alt == "A" ~ 1,
      policy[alt == "A"] == "Results presented in half-day workshop to policymakers" & alt == "B" ~ 0,
      policy[alt == "B"] == "Results presented in half-day workshop to policymakers" & alt == "B" ~ 1,
      policy[alt == "B"] == "Results presented in half-day workshop to policymakers" & alt == "A" ~ 0,
      policy[alt == "A"] == "Report of results submitted to policymakers" & policy[alt == "B"] != "Results presented in half-day workshop to policymakers" & alt == "A" ~ 1,
      policy[alt == "A"] == "Report of results submitted to policymakers" & policy[alt == "B"] != "Results presented in half-day workshop to policymakers" & alt == "B" ~ 0,
      policy[alt == "B"] == "Report of results submitted to policymakers" & policy[alt == "A"] != "Results presented in half-day workshop to policymakers" & alt == "A" ~ 0,
      policy[alt == "B"] == "Report of results submitted to policymakers" & policy[alt == "A"] != "Results presented in half-day workshop to policymakers" & alt == "B" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    
    chosen_dominant_rrpolicy_v1 = case_when(
      is.na(dominant_rrpolicy_v1) ~ NA,
      (option_selected == 1 & dominant_rrpolicy_v1[alt == "A"] == 1) | (option_selected == 0 & dominant_rrpolicy_v1[alt == "B"] == 1) ~ 1,
      (option_selected == 1 & dominant_rrpolicy_v1[alt == "A"] == 0) | (option_selected == 0 & dominant_rrpolicy_v1[alt == "B"] == 0) ~ 0,
    ),
    
    dominant_rrpolicy_v1_comp_delta = case_when(
      is.na(dominant_rrpolicy_v1) ~ NA,
      TRUE ~ comp[dominant_rrpolicy_v1 == 1] - comp[dominant_rrpolicy_v1 == 0]
    ),
    
    dominant_rrpolicy_v2 = case_when(
      policy[alt == "A"] == policy[alt == "B"] ~ NA,
      policy[alt == "A"] == "Report of results submitted to policymakers" & alt == "A" ~ 1,
      policy[alt == "A"] == "Report of results submitted to policymakers" & alt == "B" ~ 0,
      policy[alt == "B"] == "Report of results submitted to policymakers" & alt == "B" ~ 1,
      policy[alt == "B"] == "Report of results submitted to policymakers" & alt == "A" ~ 0,
      policy[alt == "A"] == "Results presented in half-day workshop to policymakers" & policy[alt == "B"] != "Report of results submitted to policymakers" & alt == "A" ~ 1,
      policy[alt == "A"] == "Results presented in half-day workshop to policymakers" & policy[alt == "B"] != "Report of results submitted to policymakers" & alt == "B" ~ 0,
      policy[alt == "B"] == "Results presented in half-day workshop to policymakers" & policy[alt == "A"] != "Report of results submitted to policymakers" & alt == "A" ~ 0,
      policy[alt == "B"] == "Results presented in half-day workshop to policymakers" & policy[alt == "A"] != "Report of results submitted to policymakers" & alt == "B" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    
    chosen_dominant_rrpolicy_v2 = case_when(
      is.na(dominant_rrpolicy_v2) ~ NA,
      (option_selected == 1 & dominant_rrpolicy_v2[alt == "A"] == 1) | (option_selected == 0 & dominant_rrpolicy_v2[alt == "B"] == 1) ~ 1,
      (option_selected == 1 & dominant_rrpolicy_v2[alt == "A"] == 0) | (option_selected == 0 & dominant_rrpolicy_v2[alt == "B"] == 0) ~ 0,
    ),
    
    dominant_rrpolicy_v2_comp_delta = case_when(
      is.na(dominant_rrpolicy_v2) ~ NA,
      TRUE ~ comp[dominant_rrpolicy_v2 == 1] - comp[dominant_rrpolicy_v2 == 0]
    )
  ) %>% ungroup()

dce_long <- dce_long %>%
  mutate(
    respondentID = as.numeric(respondentID)
  )

dce_long_predrop <- dce_long

# Drop the inattentive participants 
dce_long <- subset(dce_long, as.numeric(exercise_comment) < 3)
dce_long <- subset(dce_long, !(as.numeric(interviewer) == 1 & districtID != 1))  # DistrictID is 1 for all of Dar. Dar interviewer 1 is fine, just Kagera interviewer 1 is a problem. If you change this logic, also update the main dataset and the other analyses!

dce_long <- dce_long %>%
  group_by(game_id) %>%
  mutate(
    same_participant = n_distinct(participant) == 1,
    same_community = n_distinct(community) == 1,
    same_policy = n_distinct(policy) == 1,
    return_results_participants_none = ifelse(same_participant, 0, return_results_participants_none),
    return_results_participants_remote = ifelse(same_participant, 0, return_results_participants_remote),
    return_results_participants_inperson = ifelse(same_participant, 0, return_results_participants_inperson),
    return_results_community_none = ifelse(same_community, 0, return_results_community_none),
    return_results_community_remote = ifelse(same_community, 0, return_results_community_remote),
    return_results_community_inperson = ifelse(same_community, 0, return_results_community_inperson),
    return_results_policy_none = ifelse(same_policy, 0, return_results_policy_none),
    return_results_policy_remote = ifelse(same_policy, 0, return_results_policy_remote),
    return_results_policy_inperson = ifelse(same_policy, 0, return_results_policy_inperson),
    lower_comp = min(comp, na.rm = TRUE),
    lower_fund = min(fund, na.rm = TRUE),
    comp_recode = comp - lower_comp,
    fund_recode = fund - lower_fund
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

write.csv(dce_long, file = "dcelongdataset.csv")
```

```{r DCE Logit Regression, eval = FALSE}

set.seed(3141592653)
dce_long$comp_scaled <- (dce_long$comp - min(dce_long$comp, na.rm = TRUE)) / 
                    (max(dce_long$comp, na.rm = TRUE) - min(dce_long$comp, na.rm = TRUE))

dce_long$fund_scaled <- (dce_long$fund - min(dce_long$fund, na.rm = TRUE)) / 
                    (max(dce_long$fund, na.rm = TRUE) - min(dce_long$fund, na.rm = TRUE))

general_pref_logit <- clogit(
  chosen ~ participant + community + policy + comp + fund + strata(game_index),
  data = dce_long
)

summary(general_pref_logit)

# Extract model summary in tidy format
general_pref_logit_tidy <- broom::tidy(general_pref_logit, conf.int = TRUE)

general_pref_logit_tidy$term <- recode(general_pref_logit_tidy$term,
  "participantResults returned to participants remotely" = "Results returned to participants remotely", 
  "participantResults returned to participants in person" = "Results returned to participants in person",
  "communityResults returned to community leaders remotely" = "Results returned to community leaders remotely",
  "communityResults returned to community in-person meeting" = "Results returned to community in-person meeting",
  "policyReport of results submitted to policymakers" = "Report of results submitted to policymakers",
  "policyResults presented in half-day workshop to policymakers" = "Results presented in half-day workshop to policymakers",
  "comp" = "Compensation",
  "fund" = "Research Funding"
)


# Basic coefficient plot
ggplot(general_pref_logit_tidy, aes(x = estimate, y = reorder(term, estimate))) +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue", size = 3) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), height = 0.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray") +
  labs(
    title = "Estimated Coefficients - Conditional Logit Model",
    x = "Log-Odds Estimate (±95% CI)",
    y = "Feature"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r DCE Dominant Choice Graphs, eval = FALSE}
# Research Funding vs. Compensation Differential
fundinganalysisdataset <- subset(dce_long, comp_delta != 0 & fund_delta != 0)
participantanalysisdataset <- subset(dce_long, comp_delta != 0 & !is.na(return_results_participants_chosen))


summary_data <- fundinganalysisdataset %>%
  group_by(dominant_funding_comp_delta) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_chose_dominant = mean(chosen_dominant_fund, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_chose_dominant = sd(chosen_dominant_fund, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),  # standard error
    n = n()
  )%>%
  filter(n > 1)

plot1 <- ggplot(summary_data, aes(x = dominant_funding_comp_delta, y = mean_chose_dominant)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_chose_dominant - se_chose_dominant, 
                    ymax = mean_chose_dominant + se_chose_dominant),
                width = 0.1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 10)  # approximate number of breaks, integers
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1)  # 0, 0.1, ..., 1.0
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Differential in Compensation (Dominant RF - Inferior RF)",
    y = "Probability of Choosing Option with Dominant Funding",
    title = "Dominant Funding vs Compensation Delta",
    subtitle = "With Error Bars and 50% Reference Line"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r DCE Regression Table (Main), eval = FALSE}
run_models <- function(data) {
  mlogit_data <- dfidx(data, idx = c("game_id", "alt"),
                       panel = TRUE, id.var = "respondentID")
  
  mixed_model <- mlogit(
    chosen ~
      + return_results_participants_remote + return_results_participants_inperson 
    + + return_results_community_remote + return_results_community_inperson 
    + return_results_policy_remote + return_results_policy_inperson 
    +  comp_recode + fund_recode
     | as.factor(game_index) + control
    ,
    data   = mlogit_data,
    rpar   = c(
       fund_recode = "n",
       return_results_participants_remote = "n",
       return_results_participants_inperson = "n",
       return_results_community_remote = "n",
       return_results_community_inperson = "n",
       return_results_policy_remote = "n",
       return_results_policy_inperson = "n"
     ),
    halton = NA, R = 1000
  )
  
conditional_model <- mlogit(
    chosen ~
    + return_results_participants_remote + return_results_participants_inperson 
    + + return_results_community_remote + return_results_community_inperson 
    + return_results_policy_remote + return_results_policy_inperson 
    +  comp_recode + fund_recode
     | as.factor(game_index) + control
    ,
    data   = mlogit_data,
    rpar   = NULL
  )
  
  list(mixed = mixed_model, conditional = conditional_model)
}

extract_estimates <- function(mixed, conditional, grp) {
  tidy_mixed <- tidy(mixed) |>
    filter(!grepl("^sd\\.", term)) |>
    mutate(
      term_clean = term,
      mixed_str  = sprintf("%0.3f (%0.3f)%s",
                           estimate, std.error,
                           case_when(
                             p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
                             p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
                             p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
                             TRUE            ~ ""
                           ))
    ) |>
    select(term_clean, mixed_str)
  
  tidy_cond <- tidy(conditional) |>
    mutate(
      term_clean = term,
      cond_str   = sprintf("%0.3f (%0.3f)%s",
                           estimate, std.error,
                           case_when(
                             p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
                             p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
                             p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
                             TRUE            ~ ""
                           ))
    ) |>
    select(term_clean, cond_str)
  
  full_join(tidy_mixed, tidy_cond, by = "term_clean") |>
    rename(!!paste0("Mixed_", grp) := mixed_str,
           !!paste0("Cond_",  grp) := cond_str)
}


models_full   <- run_models(dce_long)
models_treat  <- run_models(filter(dce_long, control == 0))
models_ctrl   <- run_models(filter(dce_long, control == 1))


est_full  <- extract_estimates(models_full$mixed,  models_full$conditional,  "Full")
est_treat <- extract_estimates(models_treat$mixed, models_treat$conditional, "Treat")
est_ctrl  <- extract_estimates(models_ctrl$mixed,  models_ctrl$conditional,  "Control")

all_combined <- reduce(list(est_full, est_treat, est_ctrl), full_join, by = "term_clean") |>
  mutate(
    Term = coalesce(custom_labels[term_clean], term_clean),
    Term = if_else(term_clean == "(Intercept)", "Intercept", Term)
  ) |>
  # desired column order
  select(Term,
         Mixed_Full,  Mixed_Treat,  Mixed_Control,
         Cond_Full,   Cond_Treat,   Cond_Control) |>
  # nicer labels
  rename(
    `Mixed Logit (Full Sample)`       = Mixed_Full,
    `Mixed Logit (Treatment)`         = Mixed_Treat,
    `Mixed Logit (Control)`           = Mixed_Control,
    `Conditional Logit (Full Sample)` = Cond_Full,
    `Conditional Logit (Treatment)`   = Cond_Treat,
    `Conditional Logit (Control)`     = Cond_Control
  )

row_order <- c(
  "Intercept",
  "Participants: In person", "Participants: Remotely",
  "Community: In-person meeting", "Community: Remotely to leaders",
  "Policy: Report", "Policy: Workshop",
  "Compensation", "Research Funding"
)

all_combined <- all_combined |>
  mutate(
    order   = match(Term, row_order),
    Section = case_when(
      grepl("^Participants", Term) ~ "Participants",
      grepl("^Community",    Term) ~ "Community",
      grepl("^Policy",       Term) ~ "Policymakers",
      TRUE                         ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(order) |>
  select(-order)

sec_pos <- all_combined |>
  mutate(rn = row_number()) |>
  filter(!is.na(Section)) |>
  group_by(Section) |>
  summarise(start = min(rn), end = max(rn), .groups = "drop")


table_out <- all_combined |>
  select(-Section) |>
  kable("html", escape = FALSE,
        align = "lcccccc",
        caption = "Mixed and Conditional Logit Estimates by Group") |>
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE,
                bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))


for (i in seq_len(nrow(sec_pos))) {
  table_out <- pack_rows(table_out,
                         group_label = sec_pos$Section[i],
                         start_row   = sec_pos$start[i],
                         end_row     = sec_pos$end[i])
}

table_out <- table_out %>%
  row_spec(8, extra_css = "border-top: 1px solid black;")


table_out   # renders the nicely formatted table
```

```{r DCE Reg Table with Treatment Status as a Control}
# 1. Custom labels
custom_labels <- c(
  "(Intercept):B" = "Intercept - Control Group",
  "control1:B" = "Treatment Status - Treatment Group",
  "return_results_participants_inperson"   = "Participants: In person",
  "return_results_participants_remote"    = "Participants: Remotely",
  "return_results_community_inperson"= "Community: In-person meeting",
  "return_results_community_remote" = "Community: Remotely to leaders",
  "return_results_policy_remote" = "Policy: Report",
  "return_results_policy_inperson" = "Policy: Workshop",
  "comp_recode" = "Compensation",
  "fund_recode" = "Research Funding",
  "as.factor(game_index).L:B" = "Game Index - 2",
  "as.factor(game_index).Q:B" = "Game Index - 3",
  "as.factor(game_index).C:B" = "Game Index - 4",
  "as.factor(game_index)^4:B" = "Game Index - 5",
  "as.factor(game_index)^5:B" = "Game Index - 6",
  "as.factor(game_index)^6:B" = "Game Index - 7",
  "as.factor(game_index)^7:B" = "Game Index - 8",
  "as.factor(game_index)^8:B" = "Game Index - 9",
  "as.factor(game_index)^9:B" = "Game Index - 10"
)

dce_long <- dce_long %>%
  mutate(control = relevel(control, ref = "0"))

# 2. Run models
run_models <- function(data) {
  mlogit_data <- dfidx(data, idx = c("game_id", "alt"),
                       panel = TRUE, id.var = "respondentID")
  
  mixed_model <- mlogit(
    chosen ~ return_results_participants_remote + return_results_participants_inperson +
      return_results_community_remote + return_results_community_inperson +
      return_results_policy_remote + return_results_policy_inperson +
      comp_recode + fund_recode |
      as.factor(game_index) + control,
    data = mlogit_data,
    rpar = c(
      fund_recode = "n",
      return_results_participants_remote = "n",
      return_results_participants_inperson = "n",
      return_results_community_remote = "n",
      return_results_community_inperson = "n",
      return_results_policy_remote = "n",
      return_results_policy_inperson = "n"
    ),
    halton = NA, R = 1000
  )
  
  conditional_model <- mlogit(
    chosen ~ return_results_participants_remote + return_results_participants_inperson +
      return_results_community_remote + return_results_community_inperson +
      return_results_policy_remote + return_results_policy_inperson +
      comp_recode + fund_recode |
      as.factor(game_index) + control,
    data = mlogit_data
  )
  
  list(mixed = mixed_model, conditional = conditional_model)
}

# 3. Extract estimates
extract_estimates <- function(mixed, conditional) {
  tidy_mixed <- broom::tidy(mixed) |>
    filter(!grepl("^sd\\.", term)) |>
    mutate(
      term_clean = term,
      mixed_str = sprintf("%0.3f (%0.3f)%s",
                          estimate, std.error,
                          case_when(
                            p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
                            p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
                            p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
                            TRUE            ~ ""
                          ))
    ) |>
    select(term_clean, mixed_str)
  
  tidy_cond <- broom::tidy(conditional) |>
    mutate(
      term_clean = term,
      cond_str = sprintf("%0.3f (%0.3f)%s",
                         estimate, std.error,
                         case_when(
                           p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
                           p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
                           p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
                           TRUE            ~ ""
                         ))
    ) |>
    select(term_clean, cond_str)
  
  full_join(tidy_mixed, tidy_cond, by = "term_clean")
}



# 4. Run and format results
models <- run_models(dce_long)
est <- extract_estimates(models$mixed, models$conditional)

all_combined <- est |>
  mutate(
    Term = ifelse(
      !is.na(custom_labels[term_clean]),
      custom_labels[term_clean],
      term_clean
    ),
    Term = if_else(term_clean == "(Intercept)", "Intercept", Term)
  ) |>
  select(Term, mixed_str, cond_str) |>
  rename(
    `Mixed Logit` = mixed_str,
    `Conditional Logit` = cond_str
  )

row_order <- c(
  "Intercept - Treatment Group",
  "Treatment Status - Control Group",
  "Participants: In person", "Participants: Remotely",
  "Community: In-person meeting", "Community: Remotely to leaders",
  "Policy: Report", "Policy: Workshop",
  "Compensation", "Research Funding"
  
)

all_combined <- all_combined |>
  mutate(
    order = match(Term, row_order),
    Section = case_when(
      grepl("^Participants", Term) ~ "Participants",
      grepl("^Community", Term) ~ "Community",
      grepl("^Policy", Term) ~ "Policymakers",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(order) |>
  select(-order)

sec_pos <- all_combined |>
  mutate(rn = row_number()) |>
  filter(!is.na(Section)) |>
  group_by(Section) |>
  summarise(start = min(rn), end = max(rn), .groups = "drop")

# 5. Build table
table_out <- all_combined |>
  select(-Section) |>
  kable("html", escape = FALSE,
        align = "lcc",
        caption = "Mixed and Conditional Logit Estimates by Group") |>
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE,
                bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(sec_pos))) {
  table_out <- pack_rows(table_out,
                         group_label = sec_pos$Section[i],
                         start_row = sec_pos$start[i],
                         end_row = sec_pos$end[i])
}

# Optional horizontal line
```

```{r DCE Regression Table (Without First Two Rounds and WITH Inattentive Subset), eval = FALSE}
dce_long_dropfirsttwo_incl_inattentive <- subset(dce_long_predrop, game_index > 2)

custom_labels <- c(
  "(Intercept):B" = "Intercept",
  "participantResults returned to participants in person"   = "Participants: In person",
  "participantResults returned to participants remotely"    = "Participants: Remotely",
  "communityResults returned to community in-person meeting"= "Community: In-person meeting",
  "communityResults returned to community leaders remotely" = "Community: Remotely to leaders",
  "policyReport of results submitted to policymakers"       = "Policy: Report",
  "policyResults presented in half-day workshop to policymakers" = "Policy: Workshop",
  "comp" = "Compensation",
  "fund" = "Research Funding",
  "as.factor(game_index).L:B" = "Game Index - 2",
  "as.factor(game_index).Q:B" = "Game Index - 3",
  "as.factor(game_index).C:B" = "Game Index - 4",
  "as.factor(game_index)^4:B" = "Game Index - 5",
  "as.factor(game_index)^5:B" = "Game Index - 6",
  "as.factor(game_index)^6:B" = "Game Index - 7",
  "as.factor(game_index)^7:B" = "Game Index - 8",
  "as.factor(game_index)^8:B" = "Game Index - 9",
  "as.factor(game_index)^9:B" = "Game Index - 10"
)

run_models <- function(data) {
  mlogit_data <- dfidx(data, idx = c("game_id", "alt"),
                       panel = TRUE, id.var = "respondentID")
  
  mixed_model <- mlogit(
    chosen ~ participant + community + policy + comp + fund 
    #| as.factor(game_index)
    ,
    data   = mlogit_data,
    rpar   = c(
      fund = "n",
      setNames(rep("n", length(levels(data$participant)) - 1),
               paste0("participant", levels(data$participant)[-1])),
      setNames(rep("n", length(levels(data$community)) - 1),
               paste0("community",  levels(data$community)[-1])),
      setNames(rep("n", length(levels(data$policy)) - 1),
               paste0("policy",     levels(data$policy)[-1]))
    ),
    halton = NA, R = 1000
  )
  
  conditional_model <- mlogit(
    chosen ~ participant + community + policy + comp + fund #| as.factor(game_index)
    ,
    data   = mlogit_data
  )
  
  list(mixed = mixed_model, conditional = conditional_model)
}

extract_estimates <- function(mixed, conditional, grp) {
  tidy_mixed <- tidy(mixed) |>
    filter(!grepl("^sd\\.", term)) |>
    mutate(
      term_clean = term,
      mixed_str  = sprintf("%0.3f (%0.3f)%s",
                           estimate, std.error,
                           case_when(
                             p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
                             p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
                             p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
                             TRUE            ~ ""
                           ))
    ) |>
    select(term_clean, mixed_str)
  
  tidy_cond <- tidy(conditional) |>
    mutate(
      term_clean = term,
      cond_str   = sprintf("%0.3f (%0.3f)%s",
                           estimate, std.error,
                           case_when(
                             p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
                             p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
                             p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
                             TRUE            ~ ""
                           ))
    ) |>
    select(term_clean, cond_str)
  
  full_join(tidy_mixed, tidy_cond, by = "term_clean") |>
    rename(!!paste0("Mixed_", grp) := mixed_str,
           !!paste0("Cond_",  grp) := cond_str)
}



excl_firsttwo_incl_inattentive_models_full   <- run_models(dce_long_dropfirsttwo_incl_inattentive)
excl_firsttwo_incl_inattentive_models_treat  <- run_models(filter(dce_long_dropfirsttwo_incl_inattentive, control == 0))
excl_firsttwo_incl_inattentive_models_ctrl   <- run_models(filter(dce_long_dropfirsttwo_incl_inattentive, control == 1))


excl_firsttwo_incl_inattentive_est_full  <- extract_estimates(excl_firsttwo_incl_inattentive_models_full$mixed,  excl_firsttwo_incl_inattentive_models_full$conditional,  "Full")
excl_firsttwo_incl_inattentive_est_treat <- extract_estimates(excl_firsttwo_incl_inattentive_models_treat$mixed, excl_firsttwo_incl_inattentive_models_treat$conditional, "Treat")
excl_firsttwo_incl_inattentive_est_ctrl  <- extract_estimates(excl_firsttwo_incl_inattentive_models_ctrl$mixed,  excl_firsttwo_incl_inattentive_models_ctrl$conditional,  "Control")

excl_firsttwo_incl_inattentive_all_combined <- reduce(list(excl_firsttwo_incl_inattentive_est_full, excl_firsttwo_incl_inattentive_est_treat, excl_firsttwo_incl_inattentive_est_ctrl), full_join, by = "term_clean") |>
  mutate(
    Term = coalesce(custom_labels[term_clean], term_clean),
    Term = if_else(term_clean == "(Intercept)", "Intercept", Term)
  ) |>
  # desired column order
  select(Term,
         Mixed_Full,  Mixed_Treat,  Mixed_Control,
         Cond_Full,   Cond_Treat,   Cond_Control) |>
  # nicer labels
  rename(
    `Mixed Logit (Full Sample)`       = Mixed_Full,
    `Mixed Logit (Treatment)`         = Mixed_Treat,
    `Mixed Logit (Control)`           = Mixed_Control,
    `Conditional Logit (Full Sample)` = Cond_Full,
    `Conditional Logit (Treatment)`   = Cond_Treat,

  )
```
