```{r DCE Willingness to Pay Plots (Main), eval = FALSE}
custom_labels <- c(
  "(Intercept):B" = "Intercept",
  "participantResults returned to participants remotely"     = "Participants: Remotely",
  "participantResults returned to participants in person"    = "Participants: In person",
  "communityResults returned to community leaders remotely"  = "Community: Remotely to leaders",
  "communityResults returned to community in-person meeting" = "Community: In-person meeting",
  "policyReport of results submitted to policymakers"        = "Policy: Report",
  "policyResults presented in half-day workshop to policymakers" = "Policy: Workshop",
  "comp" = "Compensation",
  "fund" = "Research Funding"
)

get_wtp <- function(data) {
  ml_data <- dfidx(data,
                   idx   = c("game_id", "alt"),
                   panel = TRUE,
                   id.var = "respondentID")

  m_fit <- mlogit(
    chosen ~ participant + community + policy + comp + fund 
    #|  as.factor(game_index)
    ,
    data   = ml_data,
    rpar   = c(
      fund = "n",
      "participantResults returned to participants remotely"     = "n",
      "participantResults returned to participants in person"    = "n",
      "communityResults returned to community leaders remotely"  = "n",
      "communityResults returned to community in-person meeting" = "n",
      "policyReport of results submitted to policymakers"        = "n",
      "policyResults presented in half-day workshop to policymakers" = "n"
    ),
    halton = NA, R = 1000
  )

  tidy_est <- tidy(m_fit) %>%
  filter(!grepl("^sd\\.", term)) %>%                           # keep mean coefs only
  filter(!grepl("^(as\\.factor\\(game_index\\)|game_index)",   # <-- drop the controls
                term)) %>%
  rename(se = std.error, estimate = estimate)

  comp_coef <- tidy_est |> filter(term == "comp") |> pull(estimate)* (1000 / 890.58)

  tidy_est |>
    mutate(
      wtp      = (estimate / comp_coef) * (1000 / 890.58),
      wtp_low  = ((estimate - 1.96 * se) / comp_coef) * (1000 / 890.58),
      wtp_high = ((estimate + 1.96 * se) / comp_coef) * (1000 / 890.58),
      attribute = custom_labels[term]
    ) |>
    select(attribute, wtp, wtp_low, wtp_high)
}

wtp_full  <- get_wtp(dce_long)
wtp_treat <- get_wtp(filter(dce_long, control == 0))
wtp_ctrl  <- get_wtp(filter(dce_long, control == 1))

plot_wtp <- function(df, title) {
  ord <- c(
    "Intercept",
    "Participants: In person", "Participants: Remotely",
    "Community: In-person meeting", "Community: Remotely to leaders",
    "Policy: Workshop", "Policy: Report",
    "Compensation",
    "Research Funding" 
  )
  df$attribute <- factor(df$attribute, levels = rev(ord))
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = wtp, y = attribute)) +
    geom_point(color = "darkgreen", size = 2.7) +
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = wtp_low, xmax = wtp_high),
                   height = .18, color = "darkgreen") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "F1", color = "gray50") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "green") +
    labs(title = title,
         caption = "WTP in terms of USD using Tsh-USD 2021 PPP", 
         x = NULL,
           #"WTP (In USD, Relative to Compensation)",
         y = "Attribute") +
    #theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = .5, face = "bold")) + 
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-3, 11), breaks = c(-3:11))
}

p_treat <- plot_wtp(wtp_treat, "Willingness to Pay Estimates – Treatment")
```

```{r DCE Willingness to Pay Table (Main), eval = FALSE}
format_est_se_star <- function(est, se, pval) {
  stars <- case_when(
    pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
    pval < 0.01  ~ "**",
    pval < 0.05  ~ "*",
    TRUE         ~ ""
  )
  sprintf("%.2f%s\n(%.2f)", est, stars, se)
}

extract_wtp_table <- function(model, data_label) {
  tidy(model) |>
    filter(!str_detect(term, "^sd\\.")) |>
    filter(term %in% names(custom_labels)) |>
    mutate(
      attribute = custom_labels[term],
      est_str = format_est_se_star(estimate, std.error, p.value)
    ) |>
    select(attribute, est_str) |>
    rename(!!data_label := est_str)
}
```

```{r DCE Willingness to Pay Plots (Without First Two Rounds), eval = FALSE}
dce_long_dropfirsttwo <- subset(dce_long, game_index > 2)

custom_labels <- c(
  "(Intercept):B" = "Intercept",
  "participantResults returned to participants remotely"     = "Participants: Remotely",
  "participantResults returned to participants in person"    = "Participants: In person",
  "communityResults returned to community leaders remotely"  = "Community: Remotely to leaders",

get_wtp <- function(data) {
  ml_data <- dfidx(data,
                   idx   = c("game_id", "alt"),
                   panel = TRUE,
                   id.var = "respondentID")

  m_fit <- mlogit(
    chosen ~ participant + community + policy + comp + fund 
    #|  as.factor(game_index)
    ,
    data   = ml_data,
    rpar   = c(
      fund = "n",
      "participantResults returned to participants remotely"     = "n",
      "participantResults returned to participants in person"    = "n",
      "communityResults returned to community leaders remotely"  = "n",
      "communityResults returned to community in-person meeting" = "n",
      "policyReport of results submitted to policymakers"        = "n",
      "policyResults presented in half-day workshop to policymakers" = "n"
    ),
    halton = NA, R = 1000
  )

  tidy_est <- tidy(m_fit) %>%
  filter(!grepl("^sd\\.", term)) %>%                           # keep mean coefs only
  filter(!grepl("^(as\\.factor\\(game_index\\)|game_index)",   # <-- drop the controls
                term)) %>%
  rename(se = std.error, estimate = estimate)

  comp_coef <- tidy_est |> filter(term == "comp") |> pull(estimate)* (1000 / 890.58)

  tidy_est |>
    mutate(
      wtp      = (estimate / comp_coef) * (1000 / 890.58),
      wtp_low  = ((estimate - 1.96 * se) / comp_coef) * (1000 / 890.58),
      wtp_high = ((estimate + 1.96 * se) / comp_coef) * (1000 / 890.58),
      attribute = custom_labels[term]
    ) |>
    select(attribute, wtp, wtp_low, wtp_high)
}

excl_firsttwo__wtp_treat <- get_wtp(filter(dce_long_dropfirsttwo, control == 0))
excl_firsttwo__wtp_ctrl  <- get_wtp(filter(dce_long_dropfirsttwo, control == 1))

plot_wtp <- function(df, title) {
  ord <- c(
    "Intercept",
    "Participants: In person", "Participants: Remotely",
    "Community: In-person meeting", "Community: Remotely to leaders",
    "Policy: Workshop", "Policy: Report",
    "Compensation",
    "Research Funding" 
  )
  df$attribute <- factor(df$attribute, levels = rev(ord))
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = wtp, y = attribute)) +
    geom_point(color = "darkgreen", size = 2.7) +
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = wtp_low, xmax = wtp_high),
                   height = .18, color = "darkgreen") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "F1", color = "gray50") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "green") +
    labs(title = title,
         caption = "WTP in terms of USD using Tsh-USD 2021 PPP", 
         x = NULL,
           #"WTP (In USD, Relative to Compensation)",
         y = "Attribute") +
    #theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = .5, face = "bold")) + 
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-3, 11), breaks = c(-3:11))
}
```

```{r DCE Willingness to Pay Table (Without First Two Rounds), eval = FALSE}

format_est_se_star <- function(est, se, pval) {
  stars <- case_when(
    pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
    pval < 0.01  ~ "**",
    pval < 0.05  ~ "*",
    TRUE         ~ ""
  )
  sprintf("%.2f%s\n(%.2f)", est, stars, se)
}

extract_wtp_table <- function(model, data_label) {
  tidy(model) |>
    filter(!str_detect(term, "^sd\\.")) |>
    filter(term %in% names(custom_labels)) |>
    mutate(
      attribute = custom_labels[term],
      est_str = format_est_se_star(estimate, std.error, p.value)
    ) |>
    select(attribute, est_str) |>
    rename(!!data_label := est_str)
}

excl_firsttwo__wtp_full_tbl  <- extract_wtp_table(excl_firsttwo__models_full$mixed,  "Full Sample")
excl_firsttwo__wtp_treat_tbl <- extract_wtp_table(excl_firsttwo__models_treat$mixed, "Treatment")
excl_firsttwo__wtp_ctrl_tbl  <- extract_wtp_table(excl_firsttwo__models_ctrl$mixed,  "Control")

excl_firsttwo__wtp_table <- reduce(list(excl_firsttwo__wtp_full_tbl, excl_firsttwo__wtp_treat_tbl, excl_firsttwo__wtp_ctrl_tbl), full_join, by = "attribute") |>
  rename(Attribute = attribute)

row_order <- c(
  "Intercept",
  "Participants: In person", "Participants: Remotely",
  "Community: In-person meeting", "Community: Remotely to leaders",
  "Policy: Workshop", "Policy: Report",
  "Compensation", "Research Funding"
)

excl_firsttwo__wtp_table <- excl_firsttwo__wtp_table |>
  mutate(order = match(Attribute, row_order)) |>
  arrange(order) |>
  select(-order)

excl_firsttwo__wtp_table <- excl_firsttwo__wtp_table |>
  mutate(Section = case_when(
    str_detect(Attribute, "^Participants") ~ "Participants",
    str_detect(Attribute, "^Community")    ~ "Community",
    str_detect(Attribute, "^Policy")       ~ "Policymakers",
    TRUE                                   ~ NA_character_
  ))

excl_firsttwo__wtp_sec_pos <- excl_firsttwo__wtp_table |>
  mutate(rn = row_number()) |>
  filter(!is.na(Section)) |>
  group_by(Section) |>
  summarise(start = min(rn), end = max(rn), .groups = "drop")

excl_firsttwo__wtp_kable <- excl_firsttwo__wtp_table |>

  kable("html", escape = FALSE, align = "lccc",

  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover")) %>%
```

```{r DCE Willingness to Pay Plots (Without First Two Rounds and WITH Inattentive Subset), eval = FALSE}
dce_long_dropfirsttwo_incl_inattentive <- subset(dce_long_predrop, game_index > 2)

custom_labels <- c(
  "(Intercept):B" = "Intercept",
  "participantResults returned to participants remotely"     = "Participants: Remotely",
  "participantResults returned to participants in person"    = "Participants: In person",
  "communityResults returned to community leaders remotely"  = "Community: Remotely to leaders",
  "communityResults returned to community in-person meeting" = "Community: In-person meeting",
  "policyReport of results submitted to policymakers"        = "Policy: Report",
  "policyResults presented in half-day workshop to policymakers" = "Policy: Workshop",
  "comp" = "Compensation",
  "fund" = "Research Funding"
)

get_wtp <- function(data) {
  ml_data <- dfidx(data,
                   idx   = c("game_id", "alt"),
                   panel = TRUE,
                   id.var = "respondentID")

  m_fit <- mlogit(
    chosen ~ participant + community + policy + comp + fund 
    #|  as.factor(game_index)
    ,
    data   = ml_data,
    rpar   = c(
      fund = "n",
      "participantResults returned to participants remotely"     = "n",
      "participantResults returned to participants in person"    = "n",
      "communityResults returned to community leaders remotely"  = "n",
      "communityResults returned to community in-person meeting" = "n",
      "policyReport of results submitted to policymakers"        = "n",
      "policyResults presented in half-day workshop to policymakers" = "n"
    ),
    halton = NA, R = 1000
  )

  tidy_est <- tidy(m_fit) %>%
  filter(!grepl("^sd\\.", term)) %>%                           # keep mean coefs only
  filter(!grepl("^(as\\.factor\\(game_index\\)|game_index)",   # <-- drop the controls
                term)) %>%
  rename(se = std.error, estimate = estimate)

  comp_coef <- tidy_est |> filter(term == "comp") |> pull(estimate)* (1000 / 890.58)

  tidy_est |>
    mutate(
      wtp      = (estimate / comp_coef) * (1000 / 890.58),
      wtp_low  = ((estimate - 1.96 * se) / comp_coef) * (1000 / 890.58),
      wtp_high = ((estimate + 1.96 * se) / comp_coef) * (1000 / 890.58),
      attribute = custom_labels[term]
    ) |>
    select(attribute, wtp, wtp_low, wtp_high)
}
```

#{r Initial OLS and Logit DCE Regression Analysis}

#Alfredo wants standard OLS regression (lm) with controls for game index and respondent fixed effects (using dummy variables), also controlling for age and income. 
#Also logit model (no fixed effects since he says the model can't do those) and mixed logit.

#Both of these should regress the likelihood of choosing 0/1 (option A or option B) on the difference of feature levels. So, if A's participant feature is level 1, how much more likely is the participant to choose A versus a B option that has feature level 2/3/etc. Each difference should have its own variable (1 v 2, 2 v 3, 1 v 3, for each feature). Compensation and research funding are continuous, so you can use comp_delta and funding_delta. 

#Errors should be robust and clustered at the respondent level. For more info, see Kathleen Mullen's paper.
